method.stockPolicy: Cumulative stock from shops accessible at each story stage. Sovereign and non-shop mechanic motors excluded; gifted body preserved in baseline.
method.scope: 10 courses × 5 lanes × 2 builds; cumulative-shop one-part swaps; 3-lane checks for motor/tire/chassis/roller swaps; motor/gear cross products in 3 contexts. This is not exhaustive whole-build optimization.
